back_translation: O nations, come near and listen; O peoples, pay attention. Let the earth and everything in it hear, the world and all that springs from it.
For the LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He has devoted them to complete destruction; He has handed them over to slaughter.
Their slain will be thrown out unburied; the stench of their corpses will rise, and the mountains will be soaked with their blood.

All the stars of the heavens will dissolve and vanish, and the sky will be rolled up like a scroll. All its stars will fall, like withered leaves falling from the vine, like shriveled fruit falling from the fig tree.
"For My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens. Behold, it will descend upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction for judgment."

The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood and gorged with fat — with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
Wild oxen will fall with them, and young bulls with the mighty bulls. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their dust will be saturated with fat.
For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the legal cause of Zion.
Edom's streams will be turned to pitch and her dust to sulfur; her land will become blazing pitch.
It will not be quenched night or day; its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will pass through it ever again.
The desert owl and the hedgehog will possess it; the great owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch over it a measuring line of formlessness and drop a plumb line of emptiness.
Her nobles will have nothing left there to call a kingdom, and all her princes will become nothing.
Thorns will overgrow her towers, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a dwelling for jackals, a home for ostriches.
Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to its companion. There Lilith, the night-prowler, will settle and find for herself a place of rest.
There the great owl will nest, lay eggs, hatch them, and gather her young under the shade of her wings. There too the birds of prey will assemble, each one with its mate.
Search in the scroll of the LORD and read: not one of these will be missing; not one will lack her mate. For His mouth has commanded it, and His Spirit has gathered them.

He Himself has cast the lot to divide their portions; His hand has apportioned it to them with the measuring line. They will possess it forever and ever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.
